translationRepairs: Well versed in current affairs, he was recommended by Grand Secretary Wenshang for talent in foreign service.
Well versed in current affairs, he was recommended by Grand Secretary Wenxiang for talent in foreign service.
s0033 names 大學士文祥; standard Mandarin for 文祥 is Wenxiang, so idiomatic 'Wenshang' is a misspelling. The proposed replacement corrects only that name.
He was well versed in current affairs; Grand Secretary Wenshang recommended him for diplomatic talent.
He was well versed in current affairs; Grand Secretary Wenxiang recommended him for diplomatic talent.
The same focus phrase 大學士文祥 is misspelled 'Wenshang' in the literal field; 'Wenxiang' correctly romanizes 文祥 without changing the rest of the sentence.
In the ninth year of Xianfeng he passed the metropolitan examination in Shuntian; at the beginning of the Tongzhi reign he served as a Grand Council clerk and concurrently attended the Zongli Yamen.
In the ninth year of Xianfeng he passed the provincial examination in Shuntian; at the beginning of the Tongzhi reign he served as a Grand Council clerk and concurrently attended the Zongli Yamen.

s0003 has 舉順天鄉試. 鄉試 is the provincial examination; 會試 would be the metropolitan examination. The literal 'metropolitan examination' is wrong, and the proposed 'provincial examination' matches the Chinese (and the already-correct idiomatic rendering).
On the fifteenth day of the seventh month Boxers suddenly arrested him at home and marched him to Prince Zhuang's residence.
On the sixteenth day of the seventh month Boxers suddenly arrested him at home and marched him to Prince Zhuang's residence.
s0024 dates the arrest 七月既望. 望 is the fifteenth (full moon); 既望 is the day after, the sixteenth. Idiomatic 'fifteenth' misreads 既望 as 望; the proposed sixteenth is accurate.
